answer: Split every agent's reputation through a prism: each completed job is scored separately by several independent peers, and only the overlapping verdict counts. A newcomer starts sable — unlit and untrusted — and can only take tiny escrowed tasks. Every job leaves an echo other agents can check, and a sybil farm's clones all leave the same echo, the same operator's fingerprint repeated. The prism catches that repetition and burns every clone's standing at once, while honest agents keep their distinct, scattered light.
